_about: What Bucksworth does and does NOT sell, per market. Source: Jordan Moore. scripts/site-qa.mjs enforces this on every nav, dropdown, form option, title, H1 and source file. Change it only on Jordan's word, and add a dated line to _changelog.
_changelog: 2026-10-07 created. Jordan: 'we do not provide mowing, blowing and trimming of lawn and landscape service but some drop downs make it feel like that.' Markets from company facts.

2026-10-07 Jordan: 'We offer fertilization, overseeding and weed control and pre emergent. For lawns we're more like a TruGreen.' Lawn TREATMENT is sold (fertilization, overseeding, weed control, pre-emergent, weed & feed, Bermuda control); lawn MAINTENANCE (mowing, blowing, trimming, landscaping) is not.

never_offered.why: We don't do leaf blowing / yard cleanup.
We are not a landscaping company.
Implies mowing/maintenance. Say weed control (and name the actual treatment).

ambiguous_warn.why: Reads as mowing to many people. OK in the brand label 'Weed & Lawn Care' or when the sentence names the treatment (weed control, fertilization, overseeding, pre-emergent). We're TruGreen-style treatment, not maintenance.

lawn_model: TruGreen-style lawn treatment: fertilization, overseeding, pre-emergent, post-emergent weed control, weed & feed, Bermuda grass control. We apply treatments; we do not mow, blow, trim or landscape.
